# Quarter

> Quarter turns every Stripe, App Store and Google Play payment in an app into the right access, exactly once. It checks each payment with the store, unlocks the plan or adds the credits, never double-credits, never leaves a paying user locked out, and takes access away on cancel, refund or a failed renewal. The app asks one question: what does this user have right now? Credits are spent atomically and can never go negative or be spent twice. Access can be mirrored into the app's own Postgres or Supabase table.

Quarter never holds or moves money: payments stay in the app's own Stripe, Apple or Google account. It never sees card data, uses only a read-only Stripe restricted key, and stores only the app's own user ids, not names or emails.

For AI apps, hold credits while each call runs (`POST /v1/apps/{app}/customers/{user}/credits/reservations`), then settle with what it used or release on failure. A failed call costs nothing and parallel calls cannot overspend. When a user says they paid and are locked out, `POST /v1/apps/{app}/customers/{user}/sync` asks every store again.

Live today: Stripe Checkout, subscriptions and one-time payments; App Store purchases and subscriptions; Google Play subscriptions and one-time products; the access endpoint and batch access; credits with atomic spends and holds; promotional entitlements; customer resync; the mirror; signed webhooks; erasure and export. The TypeScript SDK is built and coming to npm. Planned and not built: the console and self-serve sign-up.

Every docs page below is plain Markdown. The whole set is one file at [/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt). The exact contract of every `/v1` route is an OpenAPI 3.1 document at `GET $QUARTER_API_URL/openapi.json`, which needs no key. Examples use `$QUARTER_API_URL` for the API URL, which Quarter issues during early access. Test keys start with `qk_test_`. Keep API keys on your server, never in a browser or mobile app.

## Get started

- [Overview](/docs.md): Turn every Stripe, App Store and Google Play payment in your app into the right access, exactly once, and spend credits atomically.
- [Quickstart](/docs/quickstart.md): Take a Stripe test payment to an unlocked plan, credits added, and one credit spent.
- [Concepts](/docs/concepts.md): Apps, products, entitlements, credits and customers, the statuses a purchase moves through, and the rules Quarter keeps.
- [TypeScript SDK](/docs/sdk.md): Access checks, credit holds for AI calls, purchase reports and webhook verification from your backend, with last known access during an outage.

## Connect stores

- [Connecting Stripe](/docs/stripe.md): Connect Stripe with a read-only restricted key and a webhook, and pass your user id on every Checkout Session.
- [Connecting the App Store](/docs/app-store.md): Connect the App Store, report Apple's signed transactions from your app, and point App Store Server Notifications at Quarter.
- [Connecting Google Play](/docs/google-play.md): Connect Google Play subscriptions and one-time products with a service account and real-time developer notifications.

## Integrate

- [Credits](/docs/credits.md): Charge for what each AI call used with credit holds, spend credits atomically, and sell credits with a plan or as packs.
- [Mirror to your database](/docs/mirror.md): Keep one row per user with their current access in your own Postgres or Supabase, and check access with a plain query.
- [Webhooks](/docs/webhooks.md): Event types, the signed delivery format, how to verify Quarter-Signature, and how retries and replays work.
- [User data requests](/docs/privacy.md): What Quarter stores about your users, and how to export or erase it when a user asks.

## API reference

- [Customers and access](/docs/customers.md): Ask what a user has right now, ask the stores again, grant free access, link ids, and export or erase a user.
- [Purchases](/docs/purchases.md): Report a purchase from your app as soon as the store completes it, and again on restore.
- [Credits API](/docs/credits-api.md): Hold credits for an AI call and settle what it used, spend credits atomically, and grant credits.
- [Products](/docs/products.md): Say what each store product grants: entitlements, credits, or both.
- [Apps and sources](/docs/apps.md): Create apps, connect Stripe, the App Store and Google Play, set up the mirror, and read revenue metrics.
- [Events and webhook endpoints](/docs/events.md): Read the event log, register webhook endpoints, and replay deliveries.
- [Errors](/docs/errors.md): The error shape, the status codes, and the codes you will meet most.
